item.title: PM Modi, President Emmanuel Macron to inaugurate India-France Year of Innovation 2026
item.description: NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will travel to Mumbai on Tuesday where he will meet French President Emmanuel Macron and the leaders will inaugurate the India-France Year of Innovation 2026 as per an official statement from the Prime Minister’s Office. item.title: Delhi Police celebrates 79th Raising Day; Amit Shah attends as chief guest
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Delhi Police on Monday celebrated its 79th Raising Day with Union home minister Amit Shah attending the occasion as the chief guest and reviewing a ceremonial parade. item.title: Markets open lower amid mixed global cues; turn volatile later
item.description: MUMBAI: Benchmark equity indices Sensex and Nifty began the trade on a weak note on Monday, tracking a mixed trend in global markets, but later turned volatile as investors engaged in selective buying after early losses. item.description: NEW DELHI: The Chief of the Hellenic Navy, Vice Admiral Dimitrios-Eleftherios Kataras, was accorded a ceremonial Guard of Honour at the South Block lawns in the national capital on Monday. item.title: Higher conviction in cases after full implementation of new criminal laws: Home Minister Amit Shah
item.description: NEW DELHI: After the complete implementation of the three new criminal laws in the country in the coming years, the rate of conviction in criminal cases will go up to 80 per cent, Union home minister Amit Shah said on Monday. item.description: NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday said that a nine-judge bench will commence final hearing on a batch of petitions relating to discrimination against women in religions and at religious places, including Kerala’s Sabarimala Temple. item.title: Supreme Court Constitution bench to commence hearing on definition of word ‘industry’ from March 17
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday said that a nine-judge Constitution bench will commence hearing on the contentious issue pertaining to the definition of the word ‘industry’ under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 from March 17. item.description: NEW DELHI: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Monday laid the e-foundation stone for the integrated headquarters of the Delhi Police Special Cell, describing it as the country’s “most modern centre” for tackling narcotics and terrorism. item.title: Wholesale price inflation rises to 1.81% in January
